name: Psychic Disciple
body:
Creatures of the mind, psychic disciples strive to bring their mental arts to perfection.

Requirements

To qualify to become a psychic disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Feats: At least one among Intuitive Spell, Logical Spell, or Psychic Virtuoso.
Skills: Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Sense Motive 5 ranks.
Spellcasting: Able to cast 1st-level psychic spells. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the psychic bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the psychic bloodline.
Class Skills

The psychic disciple’s class skills are Bluff (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Fly (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana, planes, religion) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Sense Motive (Wis), and Spellcraft (Int).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d6.

Table: Psychic Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+0	+0	+1	Detect psychic significance, mind of the ancestors, natural armor increase +1	+1 level of existing psychic spellcasting class
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Dex +2), bloodline feat, psychic strike	+1 level of existing psychic spellcasting class
3rd	+1	+1	+1	+2	Mental resistance, psychic development	+1 level of existing psychic spellcasting class
4th	+2	+1	+1	+2	Ability boost (Dex +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing psychic spellcasting class
5th	+2	+2	+2	+3	Bloodline feat, psychic development	+1 level of existing psychic spellcasting class
6th	+3	+2	+2	+3	Ability boost (Int +2)	+1 level of existing psychic spellcasting class
7th	+3	+2	+2	+4	Natural armor increase +3, psychic development	+1 level of existing psychic spellcasting class
8th	+4	+3	+3	+4	Ability boost (Wis +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing psychic spellcasting class
9th	+4	+3	+3	+5	Psychic development, thoughtsense	+1 level of existing psychic spellcasting class
10th	+5	+3	+3	+5	Telepathy 60 ft.	+1 level of existing psychic spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the psychic disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Psychic disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

When a new psychic disciple level is gained, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a psychic spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class. He does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if he is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting.

If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming a psychic disciple, he must decide to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Detect Psychic Significance (Su)

A psychic disciple can detect psychic significance at will, as the spell, except in a 60-ft. radius. If the psychic disciple already possesses this ability, its range increases instead to 100 ft.

Mind of the Ancestors

A psychic disciple adds his level to his sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from his bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with his psychic disciple levels to determine his bloodline powers. If he does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, he instead gains bloodline powers of the psychic sorcerer bloodline, using his psychic disciple level as his sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless he possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, a psychic disciple gains an occult protection from attacks, causing a cumulative increase to his natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As his body becomes more and more a vessel for occult forces, a psychic disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 17: Psychic Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, a psychic disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer psychic bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager psychic bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one he is advancing with his level progression.

Psychic Strike (Su)

At 2nd level, a psychic disciple doubles his sorcerer or bloodrager level for the purpose of using his first-level bloodline power.

Mental Resistance (Ex)

At 3rd level, a psychic disciple gains the mental resistance bloodline power, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. Once his level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, his bonus against mind-affecting effects increases by +2.

Psychic Development

At 3rd level and every 2 levels after that, a psychic disciple develops a new mind power, becoming an ever more accomplished mentalist. Each psychic development can only be chosen once unless noted otherwise.

Bonus Feat

The psychic disciple gains a bonus bloodline feat. If the psychic disciple belongs to a class that grants bonus feats as a class feature, he can instead gain a bonus feat of that type, stacking his psychic disciple levels and his levels in that class for the purpose of meeting the feat’s prerequisites.

Continued Studies

Choose one of the following class features: bonded manifestation, bonded senses, focus powers, implements, mesmerist tricks, mind arsenal, painful stare, psychic discipline, psychic meddler, medium spirit. The character adds his psychic disciple class levels to his effective class level in one class of his choice for the purpose of determining the effects of the chosen class feature. This does not grant additional abilities. This development can be selected more than once, but the psychic disciple must select a different class feature each time.

Extra Focus Power

The psychic disciple gains one focus power. He must meet that power’s prerequisites, if any. A psychic disciple must have access to focus powers to select this development. It can be selected more than once.

Extra Mesmerist Trick

The psychic disciple gains one mesmerist trick. He must meet that trick’s prerequisites, if any. A psychic disciple must have access to mesmerist tricks to select this development. It can be selected more than once.

Extra Phrenic Amplification

The psychic disciple gains one phrenic amplification. He must meet that amplification’s prerequisites, if any. A psychic disciple must have access to phrenic amplifications to select this development. It can be selected more than once.

Psychic Esoterica

The psychic disciple gains one of the following psychic esoterica from those listed for the esoteric knight prestige class: air walk, battle mind, confounding projection, mind connection, psychokinesis, shadow projection, and step through reality. This development can be selected more than once.

Psychic Spell-Like Ability (Sp)

The psychic disciple gains one 1st- or 2nd-level spell of his choice from the psychic list (that does not attack a creature or deal damage) as a spell-like ability that he can use 3 times per day at his psychic caster level. If the psychic disciple possesses the psychic bloodrager bloodline, he can use this spell-like ability with psychic bloodrage and greater psychic bloodrage. This development can be selected more than once.

Thoughtsense (Sp)

At 9th level, a psychic disciple gains the thoughtsense bloodline power, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. Once his level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, its range increases instead to 100 feet.

Telepathy (Su)

At 10th level, a psychic disciple can mentally communicate with any other creature within 100 feet that has a language. It is possible to address multiple creatures at once telepathically, although maintaining a telepathic conversation with more than one creature at a time is just as difficult as both speaking and listening to multiple people at the same time. If the psychic disciple already possesses this ability, its range increases instead to 150 feet.
